I find out any of you are using magic to tweak the results and I'm sure we'll get intimately acquianted in one very specific way.

There's plenty of room for advancement in the Vampire Nation. Unlike some people, I intend to accomplish quite the meteoric rise rather than simply being ennobled by being the fastest swimmer in my father's spend.
It's truly an honor to be in competition to whatever lamprey and mosquito-people you normally indulge. I'd wager the lampreys are more novel?
Fifty? Do you think I'm some destitute beggar, Zelda?
I'll bite. If these echoes are monsters... you're depraved, Zelda. But, at least you're depraved in an interesting way. Do you have any favorites?
Not exactly what you expected, huh? I get that a lot. But I wanted something that looks good and's easy to move around in. It's meant to be concealed by my coat.
Not my favorite outfit, but this's perfect for letting the night take me. Or, rather, letting me take the night.
I don't suppose any of you wouldn't mind giving the future Viscount of New York a little sip of your blood, would you? I promise I'll make it into more of those gorgeous bats.

New York may as well be the city at the center of the world. All the culture of the Old World, all the opportunity of the new!
If you call me batty, I'll introduce you to my blood bats. Yes. They are bats. They are made out of my blood.

I almost got married. Wouldn't recommend it. Stupid Arin.
If anyone wants to try out some of my fashion line, please do ask.
Oh, yeah. Vampires are real. Not like anyone'll believe you.
I keep a gun in my purse. Nothing so cliche as a Derringer or whatever. I shoot you with my blood. Then I get your blood and add it to my blood.
The Vampire Nation can be so stuck in their ways. Don't you worry your pretty little heads over it, though.

I'll admit that the voice of the New York Oracle's kinda hot. Probably not much to look at.

Making South Ixia a state's such a... novel idea. Sure, let's take the warzone into our country. At least it's not as absurd as needing two Dakotas.
Can you believe the Djinn want Wyoming of all places? Wyoming. That Wyoming.
I'm trying to figure something out. Any of you from a bunch of landlocked plains? What the hell is it that makes you all so damn nice all the time?

You're a princess. You've never thought of... ennobling some clever but guileless commoner? Helping them out of those wretched clothes, teaching them the right way to please you, and then giving them every reward in your nearly bottomless purse? Or just showing up in crotchless panties on occasion.

I fucking wish. Arin had the audacity to get shot before we even exchanged vows. The nerve!

Viscount, Hilda. I am going to simply make others recognize that I am simply the best equipped to lead the Barony, and the Ritual'll just speed up what was going to happen anyway.

Just because I haven't gotten naked for someone else doesn't mean I'm nervous, Hilda. You're all getting a gift.
Please. That's like, maybe one in ten people. We've got all types. Some great, like me. Some others... not so great.
Who? Do I look Eastern European to you?
It's American, Angela.
Depends on the type of vampire, Angela. All of us drink blood, have an allergy to sunlight, and are very difficult to kill.
Define detached. I'm a Ha. I've never had to worry about the world. It's there for me.
Don't worry. I only feed on beautiful people, Reagan. Good to know if I ever owe Vyper a favor.
Is my presence here not charity enough, Angela?
I know it's hard to believe, what with all I've accomplished, Miko.
These? It's my blood. Though, some of them are just real bats that join the feeding frenzy, Angela.
Excuse you? Just who do you think you are--
Oh, I can turn into a swarm of bats. I've got all kinds of other lovely vampire tricks, too.
I can actually enjoy meals just fine. My fortunes aren't so empty as to be bending over for every cock-swollen vagrant.
Impr--? Oh, Princess. That's adorable, but not how the world works.
I wouldn't call us... Well, no point in gussying it up now. There's what you'd consider demons, genies, and ghosts. I'm pretty sure there are other things, too.
Mine works as well as it needs to. And it doesn't need to work quite so hard as yours.
I am royalty in all but name. I will find someone suitable, when the time suits me, Zelda. Maybe you'll make a diplomatic entreaty.
A long and beautiful love story with far too many chapters left to count, Mr. Kaan.

Oh, I'm plenty dangerous. Just polite, Y'Shtola.

Oh, wow. I'm so impressed you can get lucky, I might let you get lucky with me... not.
Shit.
Again?

You suck.
The ears aren't real, but I can give rabbits a real run for their money.
Looks like somebody had a surprise in their Easter egg.
This outfit's not slutty. It's adorable. Tantalizing. Self-aware.

Hungry for more?

I'll show you a bit more, and show off a bit while I'm at it.

I'm going to take my tits out now. You'd damn well better treat them like the God-given gifts they are.
The second someone mouths off about me exposing myself is the second my mouth will find your throat.

I know you're all no stranger to undressing for... strangers. But this'll be my first time. Be... I don't know. Something.
I'd say take a picture, it'd last longer. But, you know, vampire.
Being a vampire means I can do things like tell you to take a picture and know it'll not take.
Giving you a little bit of a better view is the least I can do.

Oh? Keeping things interesting, are we?
Hm. How fortunate for the rest of you.

I know some of you can really measure up here, but...
Jeez. No need to gang up on me because I've got everything going for me.
The purse itself is more than most of you'll make in a year. Don't even think about looking at its contents.
Really? Well, if we were going by value...
These shoes are part of Lady Geist's nightwear line. I knew I had to build a whole outfit around them.

Fine.
So. Me again.
But making someone change for you is so appealing, isn't it? After all, that's the privilege of being in charge.
The banter's been fun. But... truth be told, I've never. With anyone. So I'd like to be a bit more picky.
I can hardly blame you for dousing the flames of competition. What, afraid I'll turn him into a vampire?

Have I heard of this company? You don't strike me as a Fairfax.
...Actually. I could see it.
Please. Like I need a degree with these looks and these talents.
My family hasn't spoken Korean in a very long time. My parents were born in New York State and I was born in New York City. American.
Ultraviolet... Oh, like that weird purple-yellow color? I mean, I didn't see it before I turned, but it doesn't seem to hurt...
'On't 'e sho anb'ying. When my fashion line rotates out of season, I make it available to everyone.

Well, they're dumb. You're not. I guess you could describe us as merchants, but that's selling us a bit short.
Being Viscount of the Barony of New York means having all the power over New York's shadows, and not having to deal with riff-raff from upstate, or, God forbid, other states.
Having some old lineage doesn't matter when you've risen up from nothing.

Pink and dark is an interesting color scheme. But, I'm glad you know better, Hilda.

Isn't it obvious? The looks, the culture, the style, the money? Plus, I'm going to live forever with eternal youth. Major plus.
...That'd be a problem if they weren't in whatever Barony has control over Gensokyo. But since they're not in New York, why should I care?
If you think I'm going to bend the knee, you've picked a fight with the wrong vampire.
Ugh. You're not the first overconfident god botherer to try and kill me! Must be hard knowing I'm going to look this good forever.
Are you sure? We have delightful medical and dental coverage. The cosmetic assistance is to die for, really. Though, if getting staked is on your mind, best to indulge that as soon as you can, Zelda.
However, I'll have you know that I am getting quite good at dispatching would-be hunters.
I'll have you know, however, that my fashion line's done some heavy lifting in modernizing vampire apparel.
It is quite the sight. If you'd be willing to visit my Court to my benefit, I could have it arranged that you'd see nothing but the best parts of the city.
Wives? Becoming a vampire? Well, if you're offering up royal blood, I may as--
It's such a shame when people have money and no sense of class, wouldn't you say, Nephenee?
If you love yourself, you have plenty of both, of course.
I'm a vampire. I'd still say that I'm human, at least the good parts and less of the horrifically fragile ones.
I'm doing... better.
Watch closely.
Don't be a smartass. I have plenty of blood and wits and clothes left.
I'm not in peak form, but I hardly need it.
Well. I'm not hiding any Easter eggs in my purse. Shame I couldn't get a cute rabbit theme going...
Could anyone explain the point of Easter to me? It's about fucking like rabbits and chocolate eggs or something, right?
What? You expected me to have thigh-high boots just for the occasion? You're not worth it.
I will complain that wearing two layers and then putting shoes on is a pain.

...Thank God that vampires have an affinity for rats. Can you even imagine how hard it would be to take someone seriously when their ears are flopping and all you can think about is how to show off those legs?
There's some kind of vampire bunny out in the countryside of England, apparently. I'm not stupid enough to get my head ripped off looking for it.
Not reusing these, so fangs come in handy.
Sure, some parts of this type of outfit are stupid. But fashion's about looking good. And fortunately, I always look good.
Come to think of it, do rabbits wear collars? Pets are a big no for me.
Oh no, without my collar, I'll really be unleashed!
Burn these into your memory.
Well then. Take a good look.
I'd hate to keep you all in suspense, but here's a new one for all of you.
(Hopefully these aren't too avant-garde...)
Oh? Thinking about it already? How soft, and warm it might feel?
Take a good look. You'll die happy.
I hand-stitched this. No sewing machine or anything.
When I found out I was going to become a vampire, I rage-made this.
What does a beautiful, smart, rich vampire keep in her purse...? A mystery.

A woman's purse is like a peek into her soul.
...If you make a joke about mine being empty, I'll fill my purse with your blood.
Not that I should be telling you this, but when you become a vampire, you rely a lot more on your sense of sound. So obnoxious heels just won't do.
Before you ask, no, they're not stilettos. Nor are they stilettos.
Not that my legs needed any help, but it messes with my outfit's concept to use flats.
And while I bet you're all excited to see up my dress, go ahead and wait a bit.
I know my legs are amazing. I'll give you permission to agree.
I know my underwear is incredibly pretty. I can't blame you for wanting to look.
Kind of a shame when you look pretty much the same as everyone else when you're naked. It almost makes your choice of underwear less interesting...
I could try and float the rest of the game, but if I wanted to exhaust myself for no reason I'd try and get some of the others to dress like not-trogolodytes.

Jush 'ake shure 'ou dn't 'alk wid yur mou'ful.
Thesh're 'spensive n' my teef 'r sharp...
I'm doing... better.
Watch closely.
Red wasn't my favorite color before I turned. But it's called playing to type.
They say those who can't do, teach. But if you're going to be fashionable, you should model it too.
Just so we're clear, painting the town red is a euphemism. I gave you my word that I wouldn't make a mess. I intend to keep that.
I barely even get to see this much in the mirror these days.
Sorry. Nobody's ever... you know. Actually seen them aside from me. So...
This is a rare view. I'm the only person who's ever... you know. Actually seen me naked.
(Why did I put so many fasteners back here...)
Form... sometimes requires concession to function. You don't look this good without... effort.
(Not that I haven't practiced undressing for other people. Arin really missed out.)
(Them being lusty is almost better than them being scared.)
Jesus. I'm going, let me at least try to be a vampy seductress.
I'm a fucking vampire! Can't you at least let me lean into being the one seducing you?
Please. If you can't reinvent the classics while making new beauties, there's no measuring up to me, Zelda.
Just because I've never fucked anyone doesn't mean the politics don't matter, Zelda.
Tell you what, let me turn him into a vampire, and I'll let you enjoy his constituent parts going into all your constituent parts.
...Well, either they're dead or I am. Stop asking dumb questions, Angela.
Wait, was that some kind of trick? That's basic vampire knowledge! Everyone knows that! Tch!
"Attitude?" You'll know what attitude looks like when I give it to you, Angela. I'm just helping a smart woman like you put the puzzle together.
The sunlight thing is just a curse. Not as much as being even more of a visionary designer than normal humans, but brilliance can be such a burden.
Would you sleep better if I spent an hour reading to blind children, or something?
Sorry to let you down, Priscilla. But I can go a bit more rouge...
Well, I'm certain there would be plenty of room for "freaky sex stuff" if I were having sex stuff with the right person. And you might say I've simply underleveraged in that area.
Oh, I'm not upset. Just that most people who've called me a bloodsucker aren't doing it over my looks.
Successful and wealthy, Hilda.
I think shitty people with status are way more annoying than those without it. Totally agree on the absolute pain it is.
They did. I'm proud of what I've inherited, and I deserve the good things in my life. But I can do it myself, too.
Oh, you know, who's allowed to hook up with who, who'd be the right level of scandalized...
Well, I'm certain there would be plenty of room for "freaky sex stuff" if I were having sex stuff with the right person.
I just don't think House Goneril's got quite the prestige I'm looking for. Good for you for being ambitious, though, that is pretty hot.
F-Fine. So what if I did? It's not like I want to just roll over when I'm ready to get fucked.
Am I going to have to deal with you the entire game, Zelda?
I'll have you know my inner beauty is as exceptional as the rest of me!
Suit yourself! Can't be missed if you never go away.
Being the best dressed and easily underestimated go hand-in-hand.
I'm fine. Your question was so unhinged I smudged my eyeliner into my eye when I took off my dress.
And who would fault you for wanting to, Princess? They're mine, after all.
What exactly is this response?
Yeah, it's my box. Why are you... what's surprising? Expecting fangs?
This is how it's supposed to look. I'm not sure why you all... shaved or waxed or whatever.
See? This is how it's supposed to look. Who has time to make it bare? That's weird. You're weird.
I may be a fashion icon, and I may be Mina Ha, but I am a vampire. These bats are only gonna get stronger.
Blood is the domain of the Vampire Nation. And I'm pretty good at making mine into bats. So piss me off, and you're going to have problems later.
